M140 S{bed_temperature_initial_layer_single}
M104 T{initial_extruder} S140
M204 S10000
 {if filament_is_high_temperature[0]}                                                                                                                                                                                                               
      ; 保温 
	  SET_PURIFIER_MODE MODE=3 DESIRE_TEMP=45 FAN_SPEED=0.6 DELAY_OFF=180
 {else}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
    {if temperature_vitrification[0]<=50}                                                                                                                                                                                                          
        ; 强冷      
        SET_PURIFIER_MODE MODE=1 DESIRE_TEMP=42 ALARM_TEMP=45 FAN_SPEED=0.6

    {endif}                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
 {endif}
G28 X Y
DEFECT_DETECT_NOODLE_FIRST
;===== 床面异物检测 ========
T{initial_extruder}
G90
DEFECT_DETECTION_DETECT_BED
;===== 取放头检测 =================
SM_PRINT_CHECK_SWITCH_EXTRUDER

M104 S0 T1 A0
M104 S0 T2 A0
M104 S0 T3 A0
M104 T{initial_extruder} S{nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 90}

M106 S255
M106 P2 S0
MOVE_TO_DISCARD_FILAMENT_POSITION

ROUGHLY_CLEAN_NOZZLE_WITH_DISCARD
